{{Quote|Hey! It's getting soft!"<br />"It stretches too.|[[Auren Yomm Baobab|Auren Yomm]] and [[Mungo Baobab]]|<ref name="Across the Roon Sea">{{DroidsCite|Across the Roon Sea}}</ref>}}
A '''memling''' was a complex element that could be stretched into different shapes. These mutable properties led them to be valued. When ripped in two, the two halves of a memling would attract each other.
